blurb: The Big Bear Alpine Zoo rehabilitates injured, orphaned, and imprinted wild animals, releasing most back into the wild. Animals that cannot be released remain on exhibit. The zoo houses over 85 species of mammals, birds, and reptiles native to the Big Bear Valley and surrounding areas.
extraNote: Zoo may open later or close on snowy days for snow removal · No smoking allowed on zoo grounds · No glass, aluminum cans, pets, laser pointers, scooters, skateboards, roller skates, breakable items, plastic lids or straws, or alcohol allowed on zoo grounds · No interaction with animals allowed for visitor safety · Zoo entrance at 42801 Moonridge Road, Big Bear Lake, CA
